backend: official Codex CLI with existing ChatGPT login
output_limit_note: No supported hard output-token setting verified for this CLI; identical backend defaults and frozen <=80-word description instruction in all four arms. No invented max_tokens parameter.
retry_policy: Retry only an explicit transport_error without a completed turn, at most once per request and four overall. Never retry invalid JSON, refusal, empty completed answer or truncation. Stop on auth/quota/config errors, tool activity, internal reconnect, or an unresolved started attempt.
money_spending_policy: Existing subscription allowance only. No purchase, reset credits or API-key fallback. Check included allowance before each call.
development_usage_note: Codex development conversation usage is not observable as this experimental backend usage.
provider_configuration: library-isolated: same built-in ChatGPT endpoint and existing OpenAI auth, with transport retries disabled
